priorFindingDisposition.text: v14's eighth acceptance-test class (AT-8, the seventeen unrideable AT-ARCHIVE-* keys) was absent from the specification, and the clean-cell pass condition was therefore satisfiable by a conformance report v14 itself declares report-invalid.
priorFindingDisposition.whatLanded: AT-8 is now named as a class and enumerated as seventeen map keys. The v3 at8.mapKeys list is set-equal to the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys in the live v14 conformanceReport.fixtureMemberMap.members, verified by set comparison: zero missing, zero extra, count 17 equal to v14's archiveGoldenKeyCount 17. basedOn.packagingV14.role now reads 'Supplies AT-1..AT-8' where v2 read 'AT-1..AT-7'. executesWhenRun now reads 'AT-1..AT-8 ... including the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys'. The clean-cell passProperty now requires fixtureClassCoverage to include 'every AT-ARCHIVE-* key (seventeen keys; there is no aggregate AT-8 map key)'. at8.standing correctly reproduces v14's rule that none of the seventeen carries a ride, so produced-with-evidence is the only lawful standing and not-applicable or blocked-on-ride is report-invalid. A failsIf line was added. Every one of those statements was checked against v14 bytes and is faithful.
priorFindingDisposition.whatDidNotLand: The scope at which those seventeen members are retained and reported is now stated three incompatible ways inside v3, and one of the three re-admits the very defect the finding named. See CLAUDE-G15H-V3-SF1.

findings.title: The specification never pins the conformance-report unit, and states the retention scope of the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* members three incompatible ways; under the reading its own retainedEvidence compels, the offline and upgrade reports carry coverage arrays v14 declares report-invalid.
whereTheContradictionIs: at8.exactByteIntent opens 'Per platform: fixtureClassCoverage members for all seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, each standing produced with {path, sha256}' — scope: once per platform.

retainedEvidence EV-1.exactByteIntent opens 'Per matrix cell and platform:' and closes 'AT-8 two-run identity artifacts and the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* coverage members.' — scope: once per matrix cell and platform, i.e. twelve times, not four.

retainedEvidence EV-1.suppliedBy reads 'AT-8 / AT-ARCHIVE-* on the clean cell (identity also on offline and upgrade).' — scope: the clean cell only, with one of the seventeen extended to the other two cells.

matrixCells.offline.activeClasses and matrixCells.upgrade.activeClasses each list AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY and none of the other sixteen, agreeing with EV-1.suppliedBy and disagreeing with EV-1.exactByteIntent.

failsIf carries the unqualified line 'any of the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys is missing, class-wide, not-applicable, or blocked-on-ride' with no cell or report qualifier, agreeing with neither scope in particular.

theUnpinnedUnit.statement: v3 never says how many conformance reports the matrix of one adapter x four platforms x three cells produces. The two available answers are each contradicted by part of the artifact.
theUnpinnedUnit.readingA: One report per platform, emitted on the clean cell. This is what matrixCells.clean.exactByteIntent supports — it alone among the three cells retains 'the conformance report bytes', and it opens 'Per platform:'. matrixCells.offline.exactByteIntent and matrixCells.upgrade.exactByteIntent retain environment records, artifact sets, digests and blocked-on-ride records, and retain no conformance report at all. at8.exactByteIntent's 'Per platform' agrees. Under reading A the seventeen keys are covered once per platform and v14 is satisfied.
theUnpinnedUnit.readingAFails: EV-3.exactByteIntent requires, 'Per matrix cell and platform', a conformanceReport.healthAndSubprotocol carrying 'exactly one unique {role, platform} member equal to subject.role + subject.platform', and EV-3.passProperty makes 'Omission of health without a ride fails'. EV-7.exactByteIntent likewise requires, 'Per matrix cell and platform', 'report members except runId'. Under reading A the offline and upgrade cells emit no report, so they can supply no healthAndSubprotocol and no report members, and EV-3's own passProperty fails on eight of the twelve cells. v3's top-level passProperty requires that 'every retained-evidence member's passProperty holds'.
theUnpinnedUnit.readingB: One report per matrix cell and platform, twelve in all. This is what EV-2, EV-3, EV-6 and EV-7 compel — all four open 'Per matrix cell and platform' and EV-3 and EV-7 name conformance-report members specifically.
theUnpinnedUnit.readingBFails: Under reading B the offline and upgrade runs each emit a conformance report. v14 conformanceReport.shape.fixtureClassCoverage states that 'AT-* halves and AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are required members of this array' and that 'Class-wide stand-ins, missing keys, duplicate keys, or alternative producers are report-invalid'. All seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* members carry ride None in the live v14 fixtureMemberMap, and v14 conformanceReport.shape.lawfulExemptions states that 'not-applicable and blocked-on-ride are lawful only via the ride recorded on that memberKey'. There is therefore no lawful standing for those sixteen keys in an offline or upgrade report other than produced with evidence. But at8.exactByteIntent scopes them 'Per platform', EV-1.suppliedBy scopes them to the clean cell, and the offline and upgrade activeClasses omit them. Eight of the twelve reports would carry a fixtureClassCoverage array missing sixteen required, unrideable keys — report-invalid under the contract v3 pins.

findings.operativeBite: This is the same surface CLAUDE-G15H-V2-SF1 named, moved from the clean cell to the offline and upgrade cells. v2 admitted a report-invalid coverage array because AT-8 was absent entirely; v3 names AT-8 correctly but leaves the report unit unpinned, so under the reading its own retainedEvidence compels, a run can satisfy every cell passProperty in this specification while emitting eight conformance reports that v14 declares invalid. The artifact's declared discipline is 'SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT for retained evidence'; a reader cannot determine from these bytes whether sixteen further exact-byte artifact sets per platform must be retained on the offline and upgrade cells, which is 128 artifact sets of undetermined obligation. This is a spec-internal contradiction with a v14-conflict on one horn, not a wording preference.
notRescuedBy: The unqualified failsIf line does not resolve it. It forbids any of the seventeen being missing without saying missing from which report, so it is consistent with both readings and settles neither. If anything it deepens the conflict, because read globally it contradicts at8.exactByteIntent's 'Per platform' and EV-1.suppliedBy's 'on the clean cell' in the same artifact.
The clean-cell passProperty does not resolve it. It governs the clean cell's report and is silent on whether the offline and upgrade runs emit reports at all.

v14 does not resolve it either. conformanceReport.discipline fixes 'One conformance report shape', which is a shape and not a cardinality; platformFanOut fixes 'One emission per supported platform alternative', which is emissions and not reports; healthAndSubprotocol's phrase 'For a per-platform report' presupposes a unit rather than pinning one. Because the pinned source leaves the unit open, the harness specification is the artifact that has to close it, and this one does not.
findings.remedyShape: Two honest options, both available without authoring any fixture bytes. Either pin the report unit explicitly — state that the conformance report is emitted once per platform on the clean cell and rewrite EV-3 and EV-7 so their conformance-report members are scoped 'Per platform' rather than 'Per matrix cell and platform', leaving the compatibility object, health record and CI/LV pins scoped as the evidence actually permits; or state that each of the twelve cells emits a report and extend the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* coverage members to every cell, which is executable since the eleven refusal fixtures and four capacity ACCEPT cases run as readily under a network-denied or prior-tuple-present cell as under a clean one. Either way EV-1.exactByteIntent, EV-1.suppliedBy, at8.exactByteIntent, the offline and upgrade activeClasses, and the failsIf line must be made to say one thing. This reviewer selects neither option, authors no fixture bytes, and writes no obligation text.
findings.gradeRationale: Graded SHOULD-FIX and not a blocker because the artifact binds nothing, applies nothing, is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED at DO-NOT-SEAL, and names AT-8 correctly and completely as an inventory. Graded SHOULD-FIX and not advisory because the defect is in an operative pass condition, conflicts with the pinned contract on one of its two readings, and is the unlanded remainder of a finding already raised once.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
decision.recommendation: DO-NOT-SEAL. Do not record. A v4 that pins the conformance-report unit and makes at8.exactByteIntent, EV-1.exactByteIntent, EV-1.suppliedBy, the offline and upgrade activeClasses, and the failsIf line agree on one scope for the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* members would, on these bytes, carry no remaining finding known to this reviewer.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: v3 lands the naming half of CLAUDE-G15H-V2-SF1 correctly and completely: AT-8 is named, its seventeen map keys are set-equal to v14's, and the rideless produced-only rule is reproduced faithfully. CLAUDE-G15H-V1-SF1 remains landed with all seven evidence members byte-exact and three distinct cell pass conditions. Every mechanical check is clean — subject unmoved at ce859a54 and 0444, nine of nine cited digests equal live bytes, file 08 pin equal to live, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, prohibition scan clean. One SHOULD-FIX stands: the conformance-report unit is never pinned, and the retention scope of the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* members is stated three incompatible ways, so under the reading the artifact's own retainedEvidence compels, the offline and upgrade reports carry coverage arrays v14 declares report-invalid.
